title: "Baseline ctDNA detection"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Baseline is the earliest valid dated ctDNA sample before treatment starts. If
no treatment start is recorded, the earliest valid dated sample is used.

```{r}
#| label: baseline-detection
library(dplyr)
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "actionability.R"))

samples_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"
)
cohort_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-detection-summary.parquet")
patient_path <- file.path(result_dir, "baseline-detection-patient-status.parquet")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

samples <- arrow::read_parquet(samples_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

selected_ids <- cohort |> 
  dplyr::filter(tx == 1) |> 
  dplyr::pull(id)

samples <- merge(
  samples,
  cohort[c("id", "treatment_start_date")],
  by = "id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  suffixes = c("", ".cohort")
)

if ("treatment_start_date.cohort" %in% names(samples)) {
  samples$treatment_start_date <- samples$treatment_start_date.cohort
}

samples$sample_date <- parse_analysis_date(samples$sample_date, "sample_date")
samples$treatment_start_date <- parse_analysis_date(
  samples$treatment_start_date,
  "treatment_start_date"
)

baseline <- samples |> 
  filter(id %in% selected_ids) |> 
  mutate(ctdna_detected = if_else(n_mut > 0, TRUE, FALSE)) |> 
  select_baseline_samples()

baseline_summary <- tibble(
  n_selected = length(selected_ids),
  n_accepted = sum(cohort$invitation_accepted, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_valid_baseline = nrow(baseline),
  # n_no_qualifying_sample = sum(is.na(detection)),
  n_detected = sum(baseline$ctdna_detected),
  n_not_detected = n_valid_baseline - n_detected,
  detection_proportion_valid_baseline = n_detected / n_valid_baseline
) |> 
  data.frame()

arrow::write_parquet(baseline_summary, summary_path, compression = "zstd")
```

```{r}
#| label: baseline-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline ctDNA detection summary"
#| echo: false

baseline_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
